support_intro: Help for children, parents, and internal testers.
support_delete_body: Open Quest Champ, tap Settings, choose Delete account, review the warning, and confirm. This removes the signed-in Firebase account, cloud profile, synchronized progress, and family invitations. If the app asks you to sign in again, do that first and repeat the deletion.
support_guest_body: Guest progress stays on the device. Open Settings and choose Reset local data to remove it. Removing the app also removes guest data unless the operating system restores an app backup.
support_reminders_body: Allow notifications in Android settings. Reminder sounds follow the phone’s notification-channel and volume settings. A quest can use a normal notification, an alarm-style sound, or a focus-session finish alert.
support_family_body: A parent or guardian may ask us to review, correct, unlink, or delete family account data. Include the Quest Champ nickname and the account email, but never send a password.
support_contact_body: Email the developer with the app version, device model, and a short description of what happened.
privacy_intro: Quest Champ is a habit, chore, focus, and reward companion designed for children ages 5–12 and their families. Children can use the core app in guest mode without creating an account.
privacy_guest: Guest mode stores quests, progress, rewards, settings, and world customizations only on the device.
privacy_account: Cloud accounts are for parents and guardians only. If a parent or guardian chooses an account, Quest Champ uses Firebase Authentication and Cloud Firestore. Parent account data may include an email address, Firebase user ID, display name, nickname, family role, and family information the parent chooses to enter, such as a child nickname, quests and schedules, progress, rewards, avatar and world choices, and approved family links or invitations.
privacy_google: Google Sign-In shares basic account information with Quest Champ only when the user chooses that sign-in method. Quest Champ does not collect precise location, contacts, microphone recordings, advertising IDs, or payment-card information.
privacy_use: We use information only to provide sign-in, synchronize progress, restore family data, connect approved parent and child profiles, schedule requested reminders, and operate the features selected by the family.
privacy_notifications: Reminder and focus notifications are scheduled by the device. Quest Champ does not collect a push-notification token for advertising or marketing.
privacy_family: Quest Champ is child-directed. Children use the privacy-first guest mode without an email or cloud account. Only a parent or guardian may create or use a cloud account, enter family information, or manage family linking. A parent or guardian may review, correct, unlink, or delete the information they provide.
privacy_advertising: We do not sell children’s personal information, show third-party advertising, use behavioral advertising, or intentionally profile children for marketing.
privacy_storage: Cloud accounts use Google Firebase Authentication and Cloud Firestore. The Quest Champ Firestore database is configured in Frankfurt, Germany. Google processes this information as our service provider under its applicable data-protection terms.
privacy_retention: Account data is kept while the account is active or as needed to provide the service and comply with legal obligations. Guest data remains on the device until the app data is reset or the app is removed.
privacy_deletion: A signed-in user can open Settings and choose Delete account to permanently remove the Firebase account, profile, synced progress, and family invitations. Reset local data removes information stored on that device. Families may also contact us for help with access, correction, export, or deletion.
privacy_security: We use authentication, Firebase access controls, and data minimization to protect family information. No online service can guarantee absolute security. Material policy changes will be posted here with a revised effective date.
